prompts.label: Watery diarrhea

visual.shape: very loose mushy pile with no defined form, flat and spreading but still has some texture and small soft chunks
visual.color: medium brown, slightly lighter than normal due to moisture
visual.distinguishingFeature: lost log shape completely, flat mushy mess, but still has some chunky texture - not pure liquid
visual.surface: wet and glossy, uneven lumpy texture, spreading at edges
visual.realLifeNote: Like very loose oatmeal or thick muddy slurry - has substance but no form, messy pile

prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style, simplified but accurate shapes of dog stool for a veterinary education app. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: very loose mushy pile with no defined form, flat and spreading but still has some texture and small soft chunks. COLOR: medium brown, slightly lighter than normal due to moisture. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: lost log shape completely, flat mushy mess, but still has some chunky texture - not pure liquid. SURFACE/TEXTURE: wet and glossy, uneven lumpy texture, spreading at edges. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Like very loose oatmeal or thick muddy slurry - has substance but no form, messy pile. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for.

prompts.label: Red streaks

visual.color: chocolate brown base with subtle red-tinged areas or thin red lines
visual.distinguishingFeature: thin streaks or small spots of fresh red blood on the surface - subtle but noticeable, realistic looking
visual.surface: mostly normal brown texture with a few areas where red is visible - not bold cartoon stripes, more like thin natural blood marks
visual.realLifeNote: Normal brown stool with thin realistic blood marks - like a small cut bled onto it, subtle red not bold stripes
